nodes.description: Public mapping address=>uint storing token balances; updated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping owner=>spender=>uint allowance; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as access-control gate in delegate, batchSend and the ensure modifier.
Total token supply set once in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; mutates balanceOf and allowance with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] (classic approve race condition).
Owner-only function performing a.delegatecall(b) on an arbitrary user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata.
Owner-only bulk send computing total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and emitting duplicated Transfer events.
Modifier that recomputes a Uniswap pair address and requires _from == owner || _to == owner || _from == UNI.
Internal pure function deriving a Uniswap pair address from a hardcoded init code hash.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, allowance bookkeeping and owner assignment.
Low-level delegatecall executed on an arbitrary attacker-controlled address and calldata, allowing storage takeover.
Unchecked multiplication _value * _tos.length without SafeMath, allowing overflow of the total variable.
Parameter _to of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _from of transferFrom, indexes balanceOf and allowance.
Parameter _to of transferFrom, indexes balanceOf.
Parameter _value of transferFrom, used in unchecked additions/subtractions.
Parameter _spender of approve, indexes allowance.
Parameter _value of approve, stored as allowance amount.
Target address of the delegatecall in delegate.
Calldata bytes passed to the delegatecall in delegate.
Recipient array of batchSend; its length feeds the unchecked multiplication.
Per-recipient amount of batchSend; multiplied without SafeMath.
Local total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, result of the overflow-prone multiplication.
Local _to assigned from _tos[i] inside the batchSend loop.
Loop counter i in batchSend.
Local UNI inside the ensure modifier, computed by pairFor from hardcoded factory/WETH addresses; shadows the state constant.
Local pair address returned by pairFor.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender identity in transferFrom.
msg.sender is written as the allowance owner in approve.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the privileged delegate function.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the privileged batchSend function.
msg.sender becomes the owner and initial balance holder in the constructor.
delegate executes a delegatecall on user-supplied address and calldata.
An arbitrary delegatecall can overwrite the owner storage slot and seize control.
transfer forwards its _to parameter to transferFrom.
transfer forwards its _value parameter to transferFrom.
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
The overflowable product is assigned to the local total.
The possibly overflowed total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
balanceOf[_to] += _value inside the loop uses unchecked addition.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf without SafeMath, so the credit can overflow.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
The ensure modifier runs before the transferFrom body.
The ensure modifier calls pairFor to derive the whitelisted pair address.
The pairFor return value is stored in the local UNI inside ensure.
owner is read in the ensure whitelist check that determines who may transfer.
The batchSend loop assigns _to = _tos[i].
The batchSend loop is controlled by counter i.
Loop counter i indexes the _tos recipients array.
Parameter a supplies the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b supplies the raw calldata for the delegatecall.
The constructor establishes the privileged owner account.
The constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
approve overwrites the allowance mapping entry.
Parameter _spender selects the allowance slot written by approve.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
Parameter _from selects the allowance owner slot in transferFrom.
Parameter _to selects the balanceOf slot credited in transferFrom.
